LESSON: ORDERING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: PRE-NUMBER ACTIVITIES
Topic 1.3: Ordering
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ordering, part of PRE-NUMBER ACTIVITIES in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How can you arrange play objects according to size?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ordering together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Signing/speaking skills; Learners can reason show opinion as they work with each other in

groups or in pairs while ordering play objects.

● Digital Literacy: Skill of interacting with technology as the learner uses digital devices to arrange objects.

Values:
• Responsibility: Diligence; Learner works together in groups to accomplish the task of ordering play objects.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety: Learner takes precaution as they manipulate concrete objects while ordering.

Link to other activity areas:

Learner is able to relate skills used in manipulation of play objects while ordering in Mathematics activities and Creative activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Sticks, wood blocks, plastic bottles, bottle tops, Manual alphabet number chart.
